name: Phoenix Tears
primary:
Like Fawkes' tears in Harry Potter. The ally you aim at (or you) heals 2 ❤, gains regeneration for 5 s and a phoenix mark for 60 s. If the marked one would die while it lasts, they rise from the ashes instead:
• Back to half health
• Fire resistance 10 s, regeneration II 5 s
• Hostile mobs within 5 blocks catch fire and are thrown back
self_description: The phoenix mark goes on you.
